purpose: Resolve the research-tool driver track from one completely enumerated Windows NPU device instance without using CPU SKU or CPU/NPU combination inference.

requiredInputs: Complete HardwareID and CompatibleID set for one Windows-enumerated NPU device instance
authority.statement: CPU catalog, CPUID, processor marketing name, firmware device revision and Linux AIE topology may remain research or diagnostic evidence, but none is an input to the Windows driver-track decision.

policy.preferredProductionTrackMeaning: Research-tool recommendation for a reviewed INF match; not installation, deployment, INF conversion or signing authorization.
policy.multipleDeviceInstances: Resolve each NPU device instance independently. Do not flatten several device instances into one HardwareID set.

sources.statement: The reviewed 376 kipudrv.inf contains PCI\VEN_1022&DEV_1502 and PCI\VEN_1022&DEV_17F0 models with NTamd64.10.0...22000 decoration.
The reviewed current 280 package is retained in the research corpus, but shared broad INF applicability does not make it an automatic selection or fallback.

One reviewed Windows Client host with PCI\VEN_1022&DEV_17F0&SUBSYS_20CF1043&REV_10 used an exact reviewed 376 INF/ipustack/xrt-smi stack successfully. This is a positive control, not Windows Server runtime proof.
